postExecutionCorrections.correction: A bounded nonempty descriptor span passes preflight; content measurement then fails after the requested output slot is set to the invalid sentinel. The unused slot remains unchanged and no arena bytes are imported.

Retain the first token across a second completed lifecycle, then test it while a third token is pending. The immediately last-completed token is the separate duplicate-token case. The mailbox starts this sequence at B; each completed y/r cycle appends yr, so the second completion and third pending state are Byryr.
The begin call receives only UTF-8 c, so its continuation is the one-code-unit string c; the state root remains s.
Count callback-returned descriptors before publication: initialize 1 + begin 2 + bank-commit-failed resume 1 + retry resume 1 = 5, including the successful callback output whose bank commit fails.

nativeAllocationAudit.runnerExecutableImports: Windows CRT startup and console allocator imports are recorded as harness overhead; they do not establish per-turn allocation behavior.
nativeAllocationAudit.harnessSourceReview: VirtualAlloc reserves caller storage before handler calls; printf/fprintf serialize results after test routines return. The static audit checks direct allocator references in generated module/product objects, excludes harness setup, and is not a process-wide allocation measurement.

limitations: No real provider I/O, cancellation lease, throughput comparison, or final memory-policy claim.
Caller-reserved controller storage is reported separately from native stack frames and process memory.
